title: Research: BER-TLV zero-length field returns wrong error code
description:
In wp11_proto_piv.c, the BER-TLV decoder accepts length=0. Downstream code in the signature parsing (around line 529) checks 'i >= container_end' immediately when container_len=0, which makes i==container_end true at entry. This returns WP11_PIV_ERR_SW instead of WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING, misidentifying a malformed response as a status-word error.

Research: find all call sites that parse BER-TLV responses and determine if any can receive a real zero-length container from a valid token. If not, add an explicit rejection of zero-length containers at the decoder level with WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING and a comment explaining the choice.
